summary: Phase 1 PDF-guided redesign QA on mobile Expo web preview (390x844). Verified 5 requested feature groups: (1) NEW TAB BAR — 5 tabs render with warm/orange active tint and outline Ionicons, every tab opens its screen without crashing; HOWEVER the tab ORDER is WRONG: currently 'Home · Listen · Wallet · Games · More' but the request specifies 'Home · Listen · Games · Wallet · More' (Games and Wallet are swapped). (2) LISTEN tab (/listen) works fully — title 'Listen' + subheader present, Flagship rail renders 10 tiles, AI rail renders 14 tiles, 'Explore 40,000+ live stations' CTA navigates to /stations, and Podcasts section correctly shows empty state 'No podcasts yet — check back soon.' via testID listen-podcasts-empty. (3) Tapping a Flagship tile (e.g. listen-flagship-imp_fun_talk_1003_uae → 'Talk 100.3 UAE') starts playback: MiniPlayer appears at the bottom showing station name, country · language, and pause button; Continue Listening cards then appear on BOTH Home (testID home-continue) and Listen (testID listen-continue) with the correct station; tapping listen-continue routes to /now-playing with title/artist/Stop button rendered. Tapping an AI tile (listen-ai-vip_lounge) navigates to /radio?channel=vip_lounge and the radio screen loads (channels visible, ON AIR ready). (4) HOME 'Start Listening' CTA (home-listen-cta) opens /listen; after playback it correctly relabels to 'Now Playing'. The Games quick link (home-quick-games) opens /games (Games hub). BigCoin card (122 BC), Featured Stations rail, and 'Explore 40,000+ live stations' CTA all still work. (5) NO REGRESSION: Wallet (/wallet), Games (/games), and More/Profile (/profile) tabs load correctly in the warm theme; /stations still browses/searches (search 'Talk' returned 30 rows) and Favorites/Recent mode segments switch fine. External audio itself is native-only in web preview as instructed — verified UI flow + MiniPlayer + navigation only.

ui_bugs.issue: Tab order does not match Phase 1 spec. Rendered order is 'Home · Listen · Wallet · Games · More' but requirement is 'Home · Listen · Games · Wallet · More'. In /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx the Tabs.Screen for 'wallet' (lines 45-51) is declared before 'games' (lines 52-58); swap those two blocks so games precedes wallet.

Real bigFM UAE flagship logos do not load — SafeImage falls back to letter initials ('TU', 'LU', 'BU', 'B9', 'F(', 'BM') because the favicon/logo_url on imported stations point to unreachable URLs (also occurs on the /stations Browse rail). Task expected 'real station logos'. Consider seeding proper flagship logo assets or add a curated logo map for the flagship set.

issues: Flagship & AI tiles are 110×110 with 8px gap — feels visually OK, but the letter-fallback tiles are solid violet (SafeImage default) which visually clashes with the warm cream/orange theme; consider theming the fallback background to a soft cream/orange tone when a station has no image.

action_items: HIGH: Swap the order of Tabs.Screen 'wallet' and 'games' in /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx so the rendered order matches the Phase 1 spec: Home · Listen · Games · Wallet · More.

MEDIUM: Flagship logos for imported bigFM UAE stations don't load (SafeImage falls back to violet letter squares). Either supply a curated logo/favicon map for the flagship set or serve a warm-themed fallback tile so the Listen rail looks branded.
LOW / carryover: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents (RN Web preview console warnings only).
critical_code_review_comments: listen.tsx: podcasts endpoint /api/podcasts/discover response is read as data.channels — verify the backend contract; if it ever returns items under a different key (e.g. `podcasts` or `items`) the tiles will silently disappear behind the empty state. Consider a defensive fallback to (data.channels || data.podcasts || data.items || []).

listen.tsx `continueStation`: when audio is active it uses activeChannelThumb which for imported stations is `st.favicon || st.logo_url` — but currentSeg.track_artist is used as the subtitle line. If a live station's segment gets stale artist metadata from a previous AI channel session, the subtitle may look wrong. Guard by preferring `[country, language]` join when the active source is imported.

home.tsx heroBtn: text flips to 'Now Playing' only based on `activeChannelName`. If a user has paused, the button still says 'Now Playing' which is arguably misleading — consider 'Resume' vs 'Now Playing' vs 'Start Listening' three-state logic keyed off `playing` too.
_layout.tsx tab order — see HIGH action item.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — every feature works functionally; the sole functional miss is the wrong tab order (Games/Wallet swapped) plus the flagship logo fallbacks.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 of PDF-guided redesign: Listen tab + Continue Listening + Home restyle all pass. The single functional miss to re-verify after main agent fix is the TAB BAR ORDER — after swapping wallet/games in /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx, restart mobile (Expo does not hot-reload reliably) and re-screenshot the bottom nav to confirm the visual order becomes Home · Listen · Games · Wallet · More. Everything else in this iteration passed and does not need re-testing.
rca of the issue: Tab order mismatch RCA: In /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx the JSX Tabs.Screen order determines the render order in the bottom bar. Currently `home → listen → radio(hidden) → wallet → games → podcasts(hidden) → profile`; because wallet is declared before games, the bar renders Home · Listen · Wallet · Games · More. Fix: move the games <Tabs.Screen> block above the wallet <Tabs.Screen> block. No other code change required.
